commits.message: refactor: return early when a run has no jobs
commits.author: david

files.patch:
@@ -84,9 +84,10 @@ def collect(ctx: CollectContext, client: GitHubAPI | None = None) -> RunsCollected
-    green = _last_green(client, target, failed)
-    return RunsCollected(failed_run=failed, last_green_run=green, evidence=evidence)
+    green = _last_green(client, target, failed)
+    if green is None:
+        return RunsCollected(failed_run=failed, last_green_run=None, evidence=evidence)
+    return RunsCollected(failed_run=failed, last_green_run=green, evidence=evidence)
